requirements.invariant: Every execution command requires an idempotency key; same key plus same payload returns the same logical result; conflicting reuse is rejected.
Only the highest current execution epoch and matching fence token may mutate a ChangeId.
Overlapping active targets require explicit compatibility disposition before concurrent execution.
Lease/time decisions require trusted time evidence within bounded skew.
Execution progress is append-durable and reconstructable after controller crash/restart.
UNKNOWN external effect is not NOT_APPLIED and blocks retry until reconciliation proves a safe disposition.
PAUSE/HALT prevents new consequential boundaries while preserving durable history.
Cancellation stops future work and never implies reversal of already committed effects.
Cross-system actions use durable intent/observation/reconciliation and never claim distributed ACID.
